objective: Implement a transversal execution-learning feedback loop that makes confirmed errors and preventive controls actionable in future briefs, and remediate the documentary and repository configuration prerequisites for a separate zero-model Product Leadership local readiness probe.

included: Create a transversal execution-learning feedback-loop contract.
Create a Codex confirmed-error decision protocol.
Create a reusable brief learning_context template and schemas.
Extend the general brief schema to support governed learning context.
Extend the error schema to capture cause, impact, correction, prevention and validation.
Create a consolidated Product Leadership incident ledger.
Create a Product Leadership integration-readiness view.
Add targeted LF checkout rules for immutable Product Leadership redesign sources.
Update model operating rules and ChatGPT project sources.
Update applicable registries, pending state, program manifest and continuity.
Create and run deterministic validators against the package.
Publish and verify the changes, then consume authorization 193.
excluded: Any model request, smoke request, retest, replay, regeneration, rescoring or audit.
Any Codex login, credential creation, transfer, inspection or API key use.
Any claim that authentication, exact model availability or fresh worktree custody passed.
Any mutation of INSTRUMENT_REDESIGN_191, Execution 004, Execution 005 or their evidence.
Any mutation of the Product Leadership candidate package or INT-LAB-004.
Any promotion, activation, integration, runtime or product change.
Any access to Carolina MD, Carolina Klinik, Clinical OS or another repository.
Any requirement to reveal private chain-of-thought.

implementation_sequence: Reconstruct canonical state and verify the exact parent.
Inventory existing errors, Product Leadership incidents and stale projections.
Create the transversal learning contract, Codex protocol and schemas.
Create ERR-LAB-013, PAT-LAB-012 and Product Leadership incident ledger.
Configure targeted LF checkout rules without modifying immutable blobs.
Create Product Leadership readiness view with live gates explicitly not run.
Update operating rules, project sources, applicable registry, pending, program and continuity.
Publish one implementation PR, verify remote, then publish lifecycle consumption.

required_pre_execution_behavior: Load only incident entries whose scope, surface and action intersect the brief.
Verify current applicability instead of assuming recurrence.
Map every applicable incident to an authorized preventive control.
Select the lowest-risk in-scope execution plan consistent with the brief.
Stop when an unresolved material recurrence cannot be corrected inside authority.
